Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a user's task with priority, category, completion status, and tags.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns the task.

description.description: Detailed notes or description for the task.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

category.description: Category or folder for the task.

isCompleted.description: Flag indicating if the task has been marked complete.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the task was marked completed.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-isolated collection of tasks enabling real-time sync and offline storage.
